item.title: Nvidia and SK hynix expand HBM4 supply deal for 2027 accelerators
item.description: Nvidia and SK hynix have expanded their HBM4 supply agreement for 2027 accelerator production, a report said, as advanced packaging capacity at TSMC remains the bottleneck.

item.title: Enterprise AI platform adds Kubernetes operator for on-prem inference workloads
item.description: An enterprise AI platform vendor released a Kubernetes operator for private AI deployments, adding hybrid cloud storage, backup and disaster recovery options for on-premises inference workloads.
